expansion_policy.rule: Show expand only for additional non-empty object-local fields or verified owned tables. Provenance, IDs and repeated compact annotations alone do not qualify.

resource_links_note: Related links use same-entity accessions. GO alternate term IDs are valid GO aliases; they do not grant a Gene annotation lookup or an automatic GO page. # TODO next data version: retain explicit component bindings in manifests.

table_downloads.pagination: All exact-object rows matching the current filters, read sequentially through existing scoped cursors. Abort on object/filter change; no partial download.
table_downloads.precision: Raw numeric precision; display rounding is not exported. Source/version/license retained; internal join IDs hidden.
